name: Bracers of Archery

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows, and +2 damage with them.
text: While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the Longbow and Shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with such weapons.
